recipes.title: Ratatouille I
recipes.description: Provençal vegetable stew with eggplant, zucchini, tomato, peppers, and aromatics; an adapted source-linked recipe.
ingredients: Olive oil, enough to coat the pan
Salt and black pepper to taste
Herbes de Provence or fresh basil, optional
steps: Slice the eggplant and zucchini; brown them briefly in olive oil and set aside.
Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the same pan, then add garlic.
Add peeled, seeded tomatoes. Cover and simmer until they release liquid.
Return the browned vegetables; season and gently simmer until tender.
Cook uncovered to reduce surplus liquid, keeping the vegetables intact.

recipes.title: Hummus III
recipes.description: Chickpea-and-tahini spread prepared with lemon juice, olive oil, and garlic; an adapted source-linked recipe.
steps: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight, then drain and rinse.
Simmer the chickpeas in fresh water with chopped garlic and salt until fully tender.
Allow them to cool enough to process safely.
Blend with lemon juice, tahini, and olive oil until smooth.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Simple red lentil soup with onions, carrots, garlic, and bay leaf; an adapted source-linked recipe.
steps: Sort and thoroughly rinse the lentils.
Gently cook diced onion and carrots in olive oil until softened, then add garlic.
Add lentils, bay leaf, and water or stock.
Simmer until the lentils are tender, roughly 20–30 minutes; serve hot.
